title: Industry Report | Q1 2023 TikTok Shop Quarterly
summary: Product forms. SEA closed-loop TTS; US storefront (Shopify plugin → off-platform checkout); UK–US fused cart (US viewers buy via UK live); US native Shop (in-app checkout). Alliance (creator affiliate), TSPs / MCNs / cross-border “star scouts.”
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / industry quarterly · April 20, 2023 · Full rewrite — not a stub · Data: Tabcut 2023-01-01→03-31; ID/UK/TH/VN/MY/PH estimates

Product forms. SEA closed-loop TTS; US storefront (Shopify plugin → off-platform checkout); UK–US fused cart (US viewers buy via UK live); US native Shop (in-app checkout). Alliance (creator affiliate), TSPs / MCNs / cross-border “star scouts.”

Global push. US Shop live Nov 2022; US TikTok users >140M (Jul 2022, DataReportal) — largest market, ~2× Brazil (#3); only mature market in top-10 by spend power. 2023 plan: open shops in ~12 more countries (FR/IT/ES + AU/NZ/BR…). Brazil ~150M netizens, ~1/3 TikTok loyal — cultural localization required like SEA.

2022 proof points. SEA cross-border since H1’22 → monthly GMV CAGR ~90%; UK H2 AOV +>40% YoY; Christmas cross-border GMV +270% YoY. Strategy 2023: “dual excellence, triple growth” / one store sell global; upgrade Polaris quality-merchant program (brand, creator, ads support); crackdown on fakes/pre-records. Mall (商城) live in ID (Oct’22) then TH/PH (from Feb’23) — more SEA markets next; shelf + content dual mode; cross-border sellers eligible. Year-end mega-promo GMV +136%; 2023 marketing calendar covers SEA + UK key nodes.

Q1 Tabcut GMV by market. Indonesia leads: Q1 GMV $755M (¥5.288B) = 36.7% of 2022 full-year; 158M orders; 48.929B product videos. UK: $58.96M GMV / 3.47M orders — AOV up, order count down vs Nov’22; 5.689B videos. Thailand: $459M = 69.76% of 2022 year; 62.12M orders; 23.866B videos. Vietnam: $263M / 42.26M orders / 15.692B videos (slower vs late-2022). Malaysia: $240M = 73.17% of 2022; 36.84M orders. Philippines: $172M = 48% of 2022; 60.07M orders / 10.822B videos. Overall Q1 GMV roughly 2× 2022 monthly averages. ID still #1; TH/MY/PH second tier; VN cooled; UK has headroom on creators/views.

Daily / price bands. Ramadan + CNY drove March lift; ID peak day Feb 25 ($27.267M GMV / 6.115M orders). TH peak Mar 31 ($24.795M); VN Feb 3 ($16.163M); PH/MY Mar 1 ($13.176M / $6.671M). Shared SEA spike Feb 18 (Sat + Isra and Mi'raj). UK peaks Mar 30–31 ($2.509M). Price: ID/VN/TH/PH/MY GMV heavy ≤¥100 (ID ≤¥100 = $226M); UK densest ¥100–200. High-ticket (>¥1000) GMV often exceeds ¥500–1000 band in ID/TH/VN.

Hashtags / creators. Country Top10 hashtag + creator tables in CN images (32). Estimates only; not official totals.

32 CN charts; attach on ingest.

— END —
